scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @assetforge/db && npm run build -w @assetforge/queue && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @assetforge/api" "npm run dev -w @assetforge/worker" "npm run dev -w @assetforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @assetforge/db && npm run build -w @assetforge/queue && npm run build -w @assetforge/api && npm run build -w @assetforge/worker && npm run build -w @assetforge/web
scripts.test: dotenv -e .env -- npm run test -w @assetforge/worker && dotenv -e .env -- npm run test -w @assetforge/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @assetforge/db && npm run typecheck -w @assetforge/queue && npm run build -w @assetforge/db && npm run build -w @assetforge/queue && npm run typecheck -w @assetforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @assetforge/worker && npm run typecheck -w @assetforge/web
